title: Validate AWS WorkSpaces assignment, connection and registration prerequisites
description: Validate AWS WorkSpaces assignment, connection and registration prerequisites through a read-only diagnosis of the authenticated caller. It also inspects WorkSpace state, directory-level MFA metadata, customer inactivity-policy limitations, and the existing protected domain-account status capability.
effects: inspect Amazon WorkSpaces assignment, availability, connection, registration, MFA, inactivity, and domain-account login prerequisites for ${target_upn}
diagnose WorkSpaces Not Authorized, Unauthorized User, and Authentication Failure without changing AWS, resetting a password, or running Windows remediation
